children: Situational Awareness, the artificial-intelligence-focused hedge fund founded by former OpenAI researcher Leopold Aschenbrenner that almost collapsed in late July, is again active in the markets through call option buying.
Situational Awareness has been buying options positions in stocks including Advanced Micro Devices
, Bloom Energy
, Coreweave
, SK Hynix
, and Sandisk
,  CNBC's David Faber reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter.
The moves were made last week and early this week, according to the report.

Aschenbrenner has bought "hundreds of millions of dollars worth of premium," Faber said on the business network. "It does appear that he is returning to the trade that brought enormous gains until the blowup that took place in the month of July."
Aschenbrenner's latest moves come after Situational Awareness sold a large portion of its public-equity portfolio to
after suffering steep losses during a recent technology sell-off in late July.

Situational Awareness had grown rapidly over the past several months and had generated a 439% return from the start of the year through the end of June, according to an investor letter reviewed by the
WSJ
. The firm, however, was said to have been using substantial leverage to amplify returns, leaving it exposed when AI and technology shares came under pressure.
Founded roughly two years ago, Situational Awareness had amassed more than $20 billion in assets under management, according to the
Financial Times
. Aschenbrenner became a prominent figure in Silicon Valley after publishing his 2024 essay
Situational Awareness
, which argued that artificial intelligence would dramatically reshape society.
